closing.summary: Best bits are fibre, broad essential amino acid coverage, a low glycemic index, useful vitamin E and magnesium, plus portable whole-food convenience. Weak spots are modest omega 3, added sodium, portion creep, and allergy risk. Best for satisfying snacks or meal toppings in measured portions, where the protein and fibre make them more substantial. This is a strong nut held back slightly by the salted, easy-to-overeat format.

scenes.narrationText: 27.6 grams of carbs. Fibre is 10.3 grams, helping digestion and slowing the absorption of the other carbs. For nuts, fibre and glycemic behaviour matter far more than starch.
